selection_rule: Six objects where FORGE3D has F@0.01 above 0.8, input-view LPIPS below the median and the best baseline Chamfer-L1 is more than twice ours (largest ratio first), plus two objects where the best baseline is within 15 percent of ours or better. The first pair is the sharpest full-frame input, the rest are listed by input crop size, largest first. Selected examples, not a random draw
iou_definition: Silhouette IoU between the FORGE3D render and the input object mask in the same crop and camera (front view). A weak, silhouette-only proxy.
